course.title: Power System Protection
course.department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

content.value: An 11 kV, 25 MVA star connected alternator has a reactance of 1.5 Ω/phase and negligible resistance. Differential protection scheme is used which operates when the out of balance current exceeds 25% of the full load current. The neutral of the generator is grounded through a resistance of 8 Ω. Determine the portion of the winding which remain unprotected against earth fault. What will be the value of resistance if 10% winding is unprotected.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
